The Legend of the Gruffalo

Ireland

Remote, dark forests

A terrible creature

Terror & Chaos

At night

Everyone is asleep

The Gruffalo quietly comes

A village with food

He wrecks everything

Eatsthe animals

Tramplesthe flowers

Destroysthe houses

No matter how much…

the villagers rebuild

he comes back.

One day

Enough of the devastation

They hunt the Gruffalo

To his cave

In the cave

Dozens of mice, talking

The Gruffalo, head down

A pile of cheese and seeds

The mice

They manipulated the Gruffalo

Captured by the villagers

Nice again

He helped the villagers

Rebuild the village

Plow the fields

Description

The End
